## Activity

During October 2023, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 98 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and indicates the volume of work completed at the site. The capture count is reported as recorded, with no adjustment or further interpretation applied.

## Image quality

Of the 98 captures, 7 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.1. The ungradable count and rate should be considered alongside the total activity when reviewing image quality for Oakridge Primary Care. These figures identify the proportion of captures that could not proceed to grading.

## Grading

A total of 16 results were referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. Together, these measures summarise the grading outcome and timeliness for October 2023. The figures provide the reported position for Oakridge Primary Care during the month and should be used as the basis for routine site monitoring.
